approval_source.question_set: The status page's head age (monitoring M2)

decisions.question: D12-Q02
decisions.rule: The endpoint's status page answers 503 when the newest block is more than 60 seconds old: about 12 missed blocks at the chain's 4 to 5 second pace, so a few slow rounds do not alarm and an uptime checker polling each minute sees a halt within about 2 minutes.

does_not_authorize: any run on a real host
